title: associate statements
description: Artifact B of a run (issue #4): the model's output, where each claim carries evidence references into the walk. A reference into a recorded read range proves the agent encountered those lines, not that they support the claim.

not_fully_read.description: Set by the tool that truncated, never by the model.

plumbing_only.description: True when the artifact came from a stub adapter: plumbing verified, model reliability not.

status.description: unreferenced marks a claim with no evidence reference at all.

check.description: encountered = the walk shows this line was read; unverifiable = it does not.
